optionFeedback.Mitä nämä esineet ovat?: Correct. The bounded plural classification frame begins with Mitä and ends with ovat.
optionFeedback.Mikä nämä esineet ovat?: “Mikä” is the singular identity-question word used in this bounded frame; use “Mitä”, the plural classification-question word used in this bounded frame.
optionFeedback.Nämä esineet ovat?: “Nämä” is a plural nominative form for referents near the speaker; use “Mitä”, the plural classification-question word used in this bounded frame.
optionFeedback.Mitä nämä esineet on?: “on” is the singular affirmative form of olla; use “ovat”, the plural affirmative form of olla.
